title: Rethinking the design space of Vanilla Pixel Diffusion Transformers
why_read: A technical paper on improving pixel-space diffusion transformers, relevant to image/video generation researchers.
analysis: This paper investigates how diffusion models decide what quantity to predict at each denoising step, comparing predicting the final clean image directly versus predicting a velocity/direction, and proposes a learned blend called MFlow. It also identifies that these models lose high-frequency image detail and fixes it with a small add-on module trained adversarially after the fact. This is solid applied research for people working on image/video generative models, though fairly narrow in audience.
